fato_historico: 1793: French playwright, journalist and feminist Olympe de Gouges is guillotined.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a powerful call to honor your voice, much like the courageous spirits of history who stood firm for their beliefs. It is a good time to consider how your emotional depth can fuel your creative passion. Let your intuition guide you toward personal liberation and trust that your gentle influence carries immense, transformative strength today.
frase_do_dia: Your voice is a powerful instrument of change and inner truth.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual wisdom and hidden personal potential.
conselho: Speak your truth clearly and stand firmly behind your beautiful, heartfelt convictions.
